findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "send_inquiry" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "scan_analytics" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Free check of how a website or online store measures traffic and sales: Google Tag Manager, GA4 and e-commerce events, consent banner and Consent Mode v2, serve…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, search_site · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, search_site · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
